scenes.text: An algebraic expression uses symbols and numbers. Substitute a value for the letter to evaluate it.
Evaluate 4x plus 3 when x equals 12. The answer is 51. Substitute x equals 12: 4 times 12 plus 3 equals 51.
A fee on a football field is 2 cedis plus 2 cedis per item. For 7 items, what is the total? Pause the video and think.
A fee on a football field is 2 cedis plus 2 cedis per item. For 7 items, what is the total? The answer is 16. Substitute x equals 7: 2 times 7 plus 2 equals 16.
